english.meaning: to shoot out suddenly, such as tears or a jet of liquid
english.note: This meaning is less certain: it was read from a few recorded conversations.

exampleSentences.english: Yeah, yeah! Just like that! Wow, it hurts so much—tears are shooting out of my eyes.
exampleSentences.traditional: 會啊！會啊！就係噉樣囖！嘩！痛到我呢，誒，眼淚水都標埋出來。
